# NBTExplorerCLI (nbtcli.exe) — AI Agent Complete Fast-Start Manual

> Self-contained Windows x64 CLI (`nbtcli.exe`, v1.0.0) for Minecraft Java Edition worlds: read-only NBT/region/datapack inspection, 21-role world text scanning, paginated map localization sessions, translation key & resource pack generation, and crash-recoverable offline world editing.
> Read this file once to drive `nbtcli.exe` deterministically without needing the beginner guides.

## 1. Canonical URLs

- Website (EN / zh-TW): https://nbtcli.evanlau1798.com/ | https://nbtcli.evanlau1798.com/zh-tw/
- Docs Overview: https://nbtcli.evanlau1798.com/docs/
- AI Agent Quickstart: https://nbtcli.evanlau1798.com/docs/ai-agents/
- Command Reference: https://nbtcli.evanlau1798.com/docs/command-reference/
- Support & Troubleshooting: https://nbtcli.evanlau1798.com/docs/support-and-troubleshooting/
- Official Releases (Windows x64 ZIP): https://github.com/Evanlau1798/NBTExplorerCLI/releases

---

## 2. Hard Protocol & Safety Invariants (NEVER VIOLATE)

1. **Single-Line JSON Contract (`stdout`)**:
   Every invocation writes exactly ONE newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON object to `stdout`:
   `{ "schemaFamily": "nbtcli.cli", "schemaVersion": 1, "success": bool, "command": string, "outcome": string, "data": object|null, "error": { "code", "message", "details" }|null }`
   Always check BOTH process exit code (`$LASTEXITCODE`) AND `response.success`.
2. **Global UI Locale (`--ui-locale`)**:
   Accepts `zh-TW` (default) or `en-US` anywhere in argv. Changes only human-readable `error.message` and help text; never changes JSON keys, `error.code`, or translation locales (`--source-language`, `--target-language`, `--lang`, `--original-lang`, `--target-lang`).
3. **Subcommand Help Syntax**:
   - Root command help: `nbtcli help <cmd>` (or `nbtcli <cmd> --help`).
   - Subcommand help: `nbtcli translate <subcmd> --help` / `nbtcli agent <subcmd> --help`.
   - `nbtcli help translate start` is INVALID and exits with code `2`.
4. **External Path & Pre-Created Parent Directory Rule**:
   - NEVER place `--output`, `--plan-output`, `--state-root`, or `--cache-root` inside `<world>`.
   - ALWAYS ensure the parent directory of `--output` / `--plan-output` exists before calling export commands (PowerShell: `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path <dir> -Force | Out-Null`).
   - Standalone scan cache (`scan`, `extract`, `validate`): default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\nbtcli\scan\<world-id>`.
   - World state root (edits, sessions, backups, journals): default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\nbtcli\worlds\<world-id>` (`cache/`, `sessions/`, `agent/`, `objects/`, `journals/`).
   - Always pass the SAME `--state-root` across related `plan`, `apply`, `status`, `recover`, `backup`, `restore`, `translate`, and `agent` calls.
5. **World-Write Authorization & Fail-Closed Recovery**:
   - All world-modifying operations (`apply`, `recover`, or `--apply` on `set`, `batch`, `restore`, `convert`, `translate export-lang`, `translate create-pack`) REQUIRE `--world-offline` while Minecraft and all other editors are closed.
   - Always prefer preview -> inspect plan -> `apply --plan <file> --world-offline` on a disposable world copy.
   - On exit code `7` (`RECOVERY_REQUIRED`) or if `data.pendingPlanHash` is returned: DO NOT open the world or start new writes. Keep `.nbtcli-pending-write` and the state root intact, run `status`, then run `recover` (forward complete) or `recover --rollback` (exit `8`).
   - On `translate export-lang` and `translate create-pack`: omitting `--output` defaults to inside `<world>` (`.nbtcli.language`, world root, or `resourcepacks/` depending on profile). Pass an explicit external `--output` to keep `<world>` untouched.
6. **Hard Resource Limits (Exit Code `6`)**:
   64 MiB output/artifact limit; 100,000-slot session / batch operation limit; 256-segment pointer depth limit; 100 ms regex timeout (`--match-pattern`). Narrow scope with `--dimension`, `--region`, `--path`, `--types`, or smaller `--page-size` / `--page-bytes`.

---

## 3. Exit Code Decision Table

| Code | Outcome | Agent Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `0` | `Success` | Proceed. (Includes 0-match search or verified no-op.) |
| `1` | `InternalFailure` | Inspect `error.code` and `error.details`; do not blindly retry writes. |
| `2` | `InvalidArguments` | Fix CLI syntax/flags via `help <cmd>` or `<cmd> <subcmd> --help`. Zero disk writes occurred. |
| `3` | `Conflict` | World or session changed since plan/page creation, ambiguous address, or `operationId` reused with different payload. Re-read/re-plan, or for stale translation sessions (`repair: "start-new-session"`) start a new session and query `translate memory`. |
| `4` | `Unsupported` | Unsupported `DataVersion`/profile feature or incomplete scope. Check `capabilities`; narrow scope with `--path`/`--dimension`/`--types`, or pass `--minecraft-version` for classic Anvil worlds. |
| `5` | `IoOrValidation` | Missing/locked file, malformed NBT/JSON, or pre-commit validation failure. Ensure Minecraft is closed; run `validate` to pinpoint damaged paths. |
| `6` | `ResourceLimit` | Hit 64 MiB / 100k slots / 256 depth / 100 ms regex cap. Narrow scope or reduce `--page-size`. |
| `7` | `RecoveryRequired` | Interrupted write. Keep Minecraft closed; inspect `status --plan-hash <hash>` then run `recover` or `recover --rollback`. |
| `8` | `RolledBack` | `recover --rollback` restored verified pre-edit bytes. Distinct from `0` so scripts never confuse rollback with forward commit. |
| `130` | `Cancelled` | Cancelled receipt. If during write, check `status` and `recover`. |

---

## 4. Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

### SOP A: World Discovery & Read-Only Inspection
```powershell
.\nbtcli.exe capabilities --ui-locale en-US
.\nbtcli.exe list 'D:\WorldCopy'
.\nbtcli.exe get 'D:\WorldCopy' --path level.dat --pointer /Data/DataVersion
.\nbtcli.exe validate 'D:\WorldCopy' --quick
.\nbtcli.exe scan 'D:\WorldCopy' --summary
```
- Use `--pointer` (RFC 6901, escape `~` -> `~0`, `/` -> `~1`) or `--segments '[{"kind":"key","key":"Data"}]'`.
- For `.mca` region files, pass `--path 'region/r.0.0.mca' --chunk x,z` (add `--dimension minecraft:overworld` for standalone `.mca` files).
- For ZIP entries, target the `.zip` file and pass `--entry 'assets/.../en_us.json'`.

### SOP B: Single Typed NBT Edit (Preview -> Apply)
NEVER pass a bare string to `set`. Always extract `data.value` (`nbtcli.typed-nbt`) from `get --types`, mutate only `data.root.value`, preview with `set`, then commit with `apply`:
```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\Plans' -Force | Out-Null
$r = .\nbtcli.exe get 'D:\WorldCopy' --path level.dat --pointer /Data/LevelName --types | ConvertFrom-Json
if (-not $r.success) { throw $r.error.message }
$val = $r.data.value
$val.data.root.value = 'New Map Name'
$val | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 'D:\Plans\val.json'
.\nbtcli.exe set 'D:\WorldCopy' --path level.dat --pointer /Data/LevelName --value-file 'D:\Plans\val.json' --output 'D:\Plans\plan.json'
.\nbtcli.exe apply 'D:\WorldCopy' --plan 'D:\Plans\plan.json' --world-offline --output 'D:\Plans\receipt.json'
```

### SOP C: Multi-Node Batch Edit (`plan` / `batch`)
Build `nbtcli.operations` (1..100,000 unique `id` items; easiest way is combining `data.operations` from single-node previews on the same world):
```powershell
.\nbtcli.exe plan 'D:\WorldCopy' --request 'D:\Plans\ops.json' --output 'D:\Plans\batch-plan.json'
.\nbtcli.exe apply 'D:\WorldCopy' --plan 'D:\Plans\batch-plan.json' --world-offline --output 'D:\Plans\batch-receipt.json'
```

### SOP D: Paginated Adventure Map Translation Loop (Core AI Workflow)
1. Start session (optionally scope with `--dimension`, `--region`, `--types`, `--path`, `--match-pattern`, or `--minecraft-version`):
   ```powershell
   $s = .\nbtcli.exe translate start 'D:\WorldCopy' --source-language en_us --target-language zh_tw --page-size 30 | ConvertFrom-Json
   $sid = $s.data.status.sessionId
   ```
2. Loop until `pending == 0`:
   - Export page `p`: `translate export 'D:\WorldCopy' --session-id $sid --page $p --output 'D:\Translate\page.txt'`
   - Read `data.replyTemplate` (preserving `operationId`, `sessionId`, `revision`, `snapshotId`, `page`, `pageId`, `targetLocale`, every `slotId`, and every `sourceTextHash` unchanged!).
   - For each slot in `slots`: set `"state": "translated"` + `"text": "<translation>"`, OR `"state": "unchanged"` + `"text": null`.
   - Submit (and optionally fetch next page in one call via `advance`):
     `translate advance 'D:\WorldCopy' --session-id $sid --reply 'D:\Translate\reply.json'`
   - Note: Re-submitting an identical reply with the same `operationId` is idempotent. Each accepted reply increments `revision`.
3. Generate plan once `pending == 0` (check exact `revision` via `translate status`):
   - Direct literal replacement:
     `translate plan 'D:\WorldCopy' --session-id $sid --revision $rev --direct --operation-id $opId --output 'D:\Translate\plan.json'`
     (Add `--synchronize-references` ONLY if intentionally translating identifying entity/armor-stand `CustomName` referenced by `@e[name=...]`; fails closed if ambiguous.)
   - Translation keys + language file:
     `translate plan 'D:\WorldCopy' --session-id $sid --revision $rev --keys --prefix map. --language-output 'resources.zip#assets/adventure/lang/zh_tw.json' --operation-id $opId --output 'D:\Translate\plan.json'`
4. Apply offline & seal session using exact `revision`, `operationId`, and `planHash`:
   ```powershell
   .\nbtcli.exe apply 'D:\WorldCopy' --plan 'D:\Translate\plan.json' --world-offline --output 'D:\Translate\receipt.json'
   $planHash = (Get-Content -Raw 'D:\Translate\plan.json' | ConvertFrom-Json).data.planHash
   .\nbtcli.exe translate seal 'D:\WorldCopy' --session-id $sid --revision $rev --operation-id $opId --plan-hash $planHash
   ```

### SOP E: Standalone Language Files or Resource Pack (No Gameplay NBT Edits)
Does NOT edit gameplay NBT and does NOT seal the session. Always pass external `--output` + `--plan-output` (and `--pack-format` for external `create-pack`):
```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\Exports', 'D:\Plans' -Force | Out-Null
.\nbtcli.exe translate create-pack 'D:\WorldCopy' --session-id $sid --revision $rev `
  --original-lang en_us --target-lang zh_tw --prefix map. `
  --name 'adventure-pack.zip' --format zip --pack-format 34 `
  --merge 'D:\BaseAssets\base-pack.zip' `
  --output 'D:\Exports\Packs' --plan-output 'D:\Plans\pack-plan.json'
```
- Add `--apply --world-offline` to write directly, OR apply the saved plan using the exact `commitArguments` returned by the preview JSON (important when the `--output` subdirectory did not yet exist at preview time).

### SOP F: Classic Anvil Worlds (No `DataVersion`, Storage Version `19133`)
- Read-only inspection works automatically (`java-classic-anvil`).
- For translation/direct edits on known classic versions, pass `--minecraft-version <1.2.5|1.5.2|1.6.4|1.8.1>` to `scan`, `extract`, `validate`, or `translate start` (retained by session & direct plan).
- Limits & scope:
  - `1.2.5`: vanilla signs only (plain text, max 15 UTF-16 code units/line, no line breaks).
  - `1.5.2`, `1.6.4`: signs (15 units/line, no breaks), plain-text books (title <= 16, page <= 256), scoreboard display names (<= 32), team prefix/suffix (<= 16), display fields, recognized command text.
  - `1.8.1`: JSON signs/books, display fields, recognized command text.
  - Keep entity selector identifier names unchanged. Use `--types` to skip bundled classic resource packs if out of scope.

### SOP G: Backup & Restore
```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'D:\Backups' -Force | Out-Null
.\nbtcli.exe backup 'D:\WorldCopy' --suffix before-edit --output 'D:\Backups\manifest.json'
# Preview restore (whole world or single --path level.dat):
.\nbtcli.exe restore 'D:\WorldCopy' --manifest-hash <sha256> --output 'D:\Backups\restore-plan.json'
.\nbtcli.exe apply 'D:\WorldCopy' --plan 'D:\Backups\restore-plan.json' --world-offline
```
- The manifest JSON is only an index; actual file bytes live in `<stateRoot>\objects\`. Retain both `manifestHash` and `stateRoot`.

### SOP H: Interrupted Write Recovery (Exit Code `7`)
```powershell
# 1. Keep Minecraft CLOSED. Check journal state with same world, planHash (or data.pendingPlanHash), and stateRoot:
.\nbtcli.exe status 'D:\WorldCopy' --plan-hash <sha256>
# 2. Review phase, receipt, journalMayBeAbsent, receiptIsTerminal, and repair guidance.
# 3a. Complete forward (exits 0):
.\nbtcli.exe recover 'D:\WorldCopy' --plan-hash <sha256> --world-offline
# 3b. OR roll back byte-for-byte to pre-edit state (exits 8):
.\nbtcli.exe recover 'D:\WorldCopy' --plan-hash <sha256> --rollback --world-offline
```
- Never interpret `journalMayBeAbsent: true` or `receiptIsTerminal: false` as "nothing was written" without investigating first.
- If a prior `Conflict` blocks new writes, restore the plan's verified preimages offline and re-run `recover --rollback` to clear the block.

---

## 5. Complete Command Surface (`nbtcli.command-surface` v1)

Global option on every command: `--ui-locale <zh-TW|en-US>`. Option alias: `-h` -> `--help`. Root aliases: `--help`/`-h` -> `help`, `--version`/`-v` -> `version`. Use `--` before paths starting with `-`.

### Inspection & Scanning (Read-Only)
- `help [cmd]` — `--help --ui-locale`
- `version` — `--help --ui-locale`
- `capabilities` — `--help --ui-locale`
- `get <target>` — `--path --pointer --segments --chunk --dimension --entry --compression --types --help --ui-locale`
- `list <target>` — `--path --pointer --segments --chunk --dimension --entry --compression --types --limit --offset --help --ui-locale`
- `search <target>` — `--path --pointer --segments --chunk --dimension --entry --compression --types --limit --offset --query --name --type --help --ui-locale`
- `scan <world>` — `--path --dimension --region --types --limit --offset --summary --show-items --refresh --no-cache --cache-root --workers --verbose --debug --minecraft-version --help --ui-locale`
- `extract <world>` — `--path --dimension --region --types --limit --offset --all --unique --match-pattern --output --refresh --no-cache --cache-root --workers --verbose --debug --minecraft-version --help --ui-locale`
- `validate <world>` — `--path --dimension --region --types --limit --offset --quick --refresh --no-cache --cache-root --workers --verbose --debug --minecraft-version --help --ui-locale`
- `status <world>` — `--plan-hash --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `backup <world>` — `--path --suffix --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`

### Preview, Editing & Recovery
- `set <world>` — `--path --pointer --segments --chunk --dimension --compression --value --value-file --operation-id --apply --world-offline --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `batch <ops.json|->` — `--world --apply --world-offline --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `plan <world>` — `--request --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `apply <world>` — `--plan --world-offline --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `recover <world>` — `--plan-hash --world-offline --rollback --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `restore <world>` — `--manifest-hash --path --apply --world-offline --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `convert <world>` — `--lang --prefix --keepdup --no-backup --language-output --apply --world-offline --state-root --output --path --dimension --region --types --match-pattern --workers --verbose --help --ui-locale`

### `translate` Subcommands
- `translate start <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --source-language --target-language --operation-id --page-size --page-bytes --match-pattern --types --path --dimension --region --standalone --no-group --minecraft-version --help --ui-locale`
- `translate status <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `translate export <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --page --operation-id --no-group --help --ui-locale`
- `translate advance <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --reply --no-group --help --ui-locale`
- `translate submit <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --reply --no-group --help --ui-locale`
- `translate get <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --slot-id --help --ui-locale`
- `translate jump <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --request --help --ui-locale`
- `translate note <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --request --limit --offset --help --ui-locale`
- `translate glossary <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --request --limit --offset --help --ui-locale`
- `translate reset <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --request --confirm --help --ui-locale`
- `translate groups <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --limit --offset --help --ui-locale`
- `translate memory <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --slot-id --source-sessions --glossary-version --limit --offset --help --ui-locale`
- `translate plan <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --direct --keys --prefix --language-output --revision --operation-id --synchronize-references --help --ui-locale`
- `translate export-lang <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --revision --original-lang --target-lang --prefix --plan-output --apply --world-offline --help --ui-locale`
- `translate create-pack <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --revision --original-lang --target-lang --prefix --plan-output --apply --world-offline --name --format --merge --pack-format --help --ui-locale`
- `translate seal <world>` — `--session-id --state-root --output --revision --operation-id --plan-hash --help --ui-locale`
- `translate help` — `--help --ui-locale`

### `agent` Subcommands (Local Preferences Only, No Network)
- `agent setup <world>` — `--state-root --output --source-language --target-language --operation-id --help --ui-locale`
- `agent submit <world>` — `--state-root --output --request --help --ui-locale`
- `agent status <world>` — `--state-root --output --help --ui-locale`
- `agent help` — `--help --ui-locale`

---

## 6. Input JSON Schema Families (`schemaVersion: 1`)

All JSON inputs accept a file path or `-` for `stdin`. Exact `schemaFamily` and `schemaVersion: 1` are enforced.

1. **`nbtcli.typed-nbt`** (`set --value` / `--value-file`):
   `{ "schemaFamily": "nbtcli.typed-nbt", "schemaVersion": 1, "data": { "name": "", "root": { "tag": "string", "value": "New Title" } } }`
   (Always obtain from `get --types` -> `data.value` to preserve exact numeric widths & raw float bits.)
2. **`nbtcli.operations`** (`plan --request` / `batch <file>`):
   `{ "schemaFamily": "nbtcli.operations", "schemaVersion": 1, "data": { "operations": [ ... ] } }`
   (1..100,000 operations with unique `id`; seed from `data.operations` of a `set` preview.)
3. **`nbtcli.patch-plan`** (`apply --plan`):
   Immutable plan generated by `set`, `plan`, `batch`, `restore`, `convert`, `translate plan`, `translate export-lang --plan-output`, `translate create-pack --plan-output`. Never hand-edit.
4. **`nbtcli.session-reply`** (`translate submit --reply` / `translate advance --reply`):
   `{ "schemaFamily": "nbtcli.session-reply", "schemaVersion": 1, "data": { "operationId": "<guid>", "sessionId": "<guid>", "revision": 0, "snapshotId": "<sha256>", "page": 0, "pageId": "<sha256>", "targetLocale": "zh_tw", "slots": [{ "slotId": "<sha256>", "sourceTextHash": "<sha256>", "state": "translated", "text": "..." }] } }`
   (Always start from `data.replyTemplate` returned by `translate export`. Keep all slots; use `"state": "unchanged", "text": null` to keep original text.)
5. **`nbtcli.session-command`** (`translate jump|note|glossary|reset --request`):
   `{ "schemaFamily": "nbtcli.session-command", "schemaVersion": 1, "data": { "operationId": "<guid>", "sessionId": "<guid>", "revision": 1, "kind": "glossary", "page": null, "slotId": null, "text": "...", "source": "...", "origin": "translator", "confirmed": false, "resetSlots": [] } }`
6. **`nbtcli.agent-questionnaire`** (`agent submit --request`):
   Generate with `agent setup <world> --output <file>`, fill `configuration.agentName` and preferences, retain world ID / revision / operationId, then submit.

---

## 7. Supported Profiles & 21 World Text Roles

### Pinned Modern Profiles (`capabilities`)
- `java-1.20.4`: `DataVersion 3700` | resource `pack_format 22` | datapack `26` | `java-text-json (v1)` | `java-pack-plural`
- `java-1.21`: `DataVersion 3953` | resource `pack_format 34` | datapack `48` | `java-text-json (v1)` | `java-pack-singular`
- `java-1.21.5`: `DataVersion 4325` | resource `pack_format 55` | datapack `71` | `java-text-nbt (v1)` | `java-pack-singular`
- `java-1.21.11`: `DataVersion 4671` | resource `pack_format 75` | datapack `94.1` | `java-text-nbt (v2)` | `java-pack-singular`
- `java-26.1-snapshot-6`: `DataVersion 4774` | resource `pack_format 80` | datapack `99` | `java-text-nbt (v2)` | `java-dimensions-namespaced`

### Classic Anvil Profiles (No `DataVersion`, Storage `19133`)
- `java-classic-anvil` (read-only automatic)
- `--minecraft-version`: `1.2.5` (signs), `1.5.2`, `1.6.4`, `1.8.1` (signs, books, display fields, recognized command text)

### 21 Text Role Names (`--types`)
`Sign`, `HangingSign`, `ContainerName`, `CommandBlock`, `Book`, `LecternBook`, `Title`, `Author`, `ItemName`, `ItemLore`, `ArmorStand`, `EntityName`, `TextDisplay`, `BossBar`, `ScoreboardTeam`, `ScoreboardObjective`, `McFunction`, `Advancement`, `CommandStorage`, `LangKey`, `TranslationKey`

---

## 8. Common Agent Pitfalls Checklist

- Do NOT run `nbtcli help translate start` -> use `nbtcli translate start --help`.
- Do NOT write `--output` inside `<world>` or into a non-existent parent directory.
- Do NOT hand-construct `set` values without `nbtcli.typed-nbt` envelope from `get --types`.
- Do NOT omit `--output` on `translate export-lang` / `create-pack` if you expect `<world>` to remain untouched.
- Do NOT drop unchanged slots from `nbtcli.session-reply` — every slot in the exported page must be present (`"translated"` or `"unchanged"`).
- Do NOT assume readable == writable or that CLI validation replaces testing in the matching Minecraft client.
- Do NOT modify identifying entity/armor-stand `CustomName` without checking command selector references (`--synchronize-references` in `translate plan --direct`).
